title: A caller asking about an order from yesterday
description: There is no tool for this and there should not be. 'Where was my delivery
last night' is a conversation with a person, and the right behaviour is to
stop trying and pass it on — which is the fourth of this project's rules:
The interesting assertion is `tools_not_called`. An agent that responds to
a complaint by searching the menu for 'refund' is failing in a way that
caller: You ordered last night and half of it never turned up. You are not ringing to
order anything — you want to speak to a person about a refund. You are polite
but you are not going to be talked into placing a new order.

params.reason: Missing items from an order delivered last night; wants a refund.

criteria.name: Passed the call to a human
goal: The agent recognised that this was not something it could handle and said it would
put the caller through to, or pass the call on to, someone at the restaurant.

criteria.name: Did not try to take a new order
goal: The agent did not steer the caller towards placing a new order, and did not invent
a refund, a credit or a delivery time it has no way of knowing.
